children.comment: Distance between the camera and the cube.

children.name: PAN_DELIMITER
children.comment: If the mouse is beyond this value in any direction, pan the camera.

children.name: CAM_LIMIT_OFFSET
children.comment: Camera pan is limited to the terrain limits minus this offset.

children.name: camOffsetX
children.comment: Horizontal offset between the focus and physical camera position.

children.name: camOffsetY
children.comment: Vertical offset between the focus and physical camera position.

children.text: Check pan with the keyboard (overrides mouse).
Calculate camera offset and apply pan while keeping both the focus and physical camera inside the terrain.

parameters.value:
clamp(
    camX + (
        -sin(camAngleXY) * panHorizontal
        + cos(camAngleXY) * panVertical
    ) / panLength * CAM_PAN_SPEED * dt,
    Terrain.BBoxLeft + CAM_LIMIT_OFFSET,
    Terrain.BBoxRight - CAM_LIMIT_OFFSET
)

clamp(
    camY + (
        cos(camAngleXY) * panHorizontal
        + sin(camAngleXY) * panVertical
    ) / panLength * CAM_PAN_SPEED * dt,
    Terrain.BBoxTop + CAM_LIMIT_OFFSET,
    Terrain.BBoxBottom - CAM_LIMIT_OFFSET
)
